name: Iida Suguru
source:
Suguru is the protagonist of the game. He ordered the latest model of android after having a conversation with his boss. Shy and affluent, he spends his free days reading Manga, playing video games, surfing on the net and watching porn. He has had no contact with women for a long time and quickly loses his means. After buying [url=https://vndb.org/c62018]Nanami[/url], Suguru had a hard time coping with such a pretty girl.

Suguru is quite funny as a character. He doesn't hesitate to ask Nanami to have sex with him from the day of their meeting, but he also doesn't hesitate to try to commit suicide because of his embarrassment by wanting to jump out the window when Nanami viewed his browsing history.
